name: Folded Iwan
summary: A broad pointed hall turns into a single folded minaret, drawn as one architectural ribbon.
why: The minaret overlaps the hall from x39 to43. Both rest on y75; the dome and the arch share x58. The coral fold is a surface plane fully inside the connected mosque.
risk: The wide open arch deliberately abstracts the hall. At24px the coral fold becomes a narrow side light.
sub1: A single pointed hall around clear negative space
sub2: The colored plane follows the same joined wall
reasonToChoose: You want a recognizable mosque with a broad open contour and a crisp folded edge.
